jobs.description:
Surgical Science is a global organisation and leading provider of medical training simulations and software solutions. Surgical Science is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market.
 
Together with healthcare partners and customers in more than 90 countries, we enhance patient safety and healthcare outcomes through evidence-based, state-of-the-art simulation technology that improves clinical proficiency and performance - enabling safe and effective training without putting patients at risk.
 
Our solutions are used by medical training centres, universities, hospitals, and the medical device industry for practice, assessment, and certification.
 
With offices in Gothenburg (HQ), Stockholm, Tel Aviv, Cleveland, Cardiff, Shenzhen and Hong Kong, we are a fast-growing and stable organisation in a rapidly evolving world. We foster a hybrid work culture that supports onsite and remote collaboration across teams and time zones.
 
As an ERP Application Specialist, you will be our in-house expert for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Working closely with Finance, Operations and IT, you will take ownership of developing our ERP into effective functional solutions, combining hands-on Business Central expertise with stakeholder collaboration and continuous improvement and maintenance.
 
This position will be based in our office in Gothenburg, reporting to Senior Director IT.
 
Job summary
Take ownership of Business Central and drive its continued development as the system expands across our global organization.
Partner with Finance, Operations, IT and other stakeholders to understand business needs, shape priorities and translate requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
Configure and improve Business Central across multiple global entities, including workflows, reporting, integrations, permissions and automation.
Assess solution options and recommend approaches that balance business value, cost, risk and long-term maintainability.
Ensure the system remains stable, well-configured and fit for purpose through effective system management, maintenance, testing, updates and governance.
Support reporting and integration needs, including Power BI, APIs and Excel-based reporting.
Provide second-line support and training, helping resolve issues and strengthen Business Central knowledge across the organization.
Maintain key system documentation and contribute to future ERP rollouts and implementations as new entities and functions are introduced.

 
Minimum requirements:
Minimum 3 years’ experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV, ideally in a global, multi-entity environment.
Experience in similar roles, such as ERP/Business Central Specialist/Consultant, ERP Application Specialist, Systems Manager (Systemförvaltare) or similar.
Good understanding of finance processes and accounting principles, with experience configuring, developing and managing Business Central, including workflows, permissions, reporting and AL extensions.
Experience with Business Central administration, testing, updates and ongoing system maintenance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Strong stakeholder and communication skills, with confidence working across functions and countries and supporting, guiding and training users.

 
It is beneficial if you also have any of the following:
MB-800 certification
Experience from manufacturing or medtech industry
Knowledge of Power Platform, Power BI, APIs or integrations is an advantage

 
Benefits:
🌍 Global environment (English as primary language)
💻 Hybrid work
⌚️ Flexible working hours
🏩 Optional Private healthcare
💚 Wellness allowance (Friskvårdsbidrag)
🚲 Optional bicycle lease

 
Surgical Science as an employer
Surgical Science is a global and continuously expanding organisation. You will be part of a dynamic, creative environment where we make sure to allow all employees to influence and contribute with their own unique experiences and knowledge.
 
Guided by our core values -  curiosity, respect, and perseverance - we strive to empower our people by recognising their strengths, supporting their growth, and creating opportunities to make a real impact.
 
We invite you to join us on this exciting and meaningful journey - to shape the future of medical training and improve care for patients around the world.
 
Apply today!
If you think you would fit our fantastic team and enjoy our work environment, apply as soon as possible as recruitment is ongoing. Let us meet and work out together whether we are a match!We kindly request that you apply with a CV in English.

Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .
Embedded C Developer – Transmission 
Mpya Sci & Tech is a company built by engineers – for engineers. We’ve created a workplace where you, as an employee, are always at the center. In everything we do, we strive for a high level of involvement and responsiveness to our employees' thoughts about their future roles and careers. Together, we are building a strong, inclusive, curious, and open-minded culture that offers great opportunities for our team members. We want you to work on assignments that you are passionate about, grow professionally, and maintain a healthy work–life balance.
 About the role
As an Embedded C Developer, you will play a key role in developing the transmission control software for future electric propulsion solutions. You will work on the full software lifecycle of the transmission control unit (TCU), from specifying and designing the architecture to implementation, verification, integration and testing in C. You will also develop test frameworks. We can offer you challenges that are both fun and exciting.
You will work on software that brings the driveline to life. This includes gear shift and clutch control functions, actuator control for solenoids, valves and electric motors, and sensor handling for speed, position, pressure and temperature. The software platform covers MCU low-level drivers, device drivers for all connected peripherals, and CAN and Ethernet communication stacks. It also covers RTOS configuration, the diagnostic event manager and ECU power management. On top of this, you will help improve how we work, our development tools and our continuous integration framework.
We are looking for you…
…who wants to grow as a professional and brings an open mind and a proactive approach. You have strong drive and creativity, and you come up with ideas and solutions all the way from system design to verification. You understand how software and mechanics work together in a transmission and enjoy solving problems where timing, control and hardware meet. You like working in a team but are just as comfortable working on your own.
Requirements:
B.Sc./M.Sc. in Embedded Software, Electronics, Mechatronics, Physics or equivalent education.
At least five years of experience in embedded software development and real-time systems programming.
Strong skills in embedded C for safety-critical real-time systems.
Experience developing software for transmission, driveline or propulsion systems, for example TCU, gearbox, clutch or e-axle control.
Skills in embedded software architecture, design and verification.
Skilled in Python and Git.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

It is a merit if you have experience with:
Shift strategies, torque control, clutch control or control engineering in general.
ISO 26262 (functional safety) 
AUTOSAR.
Tools such as the Lauterbach TRACE32 debugger, oscilloscopes, CANoe/CANalyzer and Robot Framework.
Electronics and actuator control (PWM, current control, solenoids).
Software development for Volvo Powertrain or another transmission supplier, which will be highly valued.

You are open-minded, proactive and structured, and you have the drive to take the lead.
Who we areAt Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life, and we’re living a culture where you can:
Be Dedicated
Be Brave and Curious
Be Inclusive and Allowing

You have real influence over your assignments and your career development, with a good balance between work and life.
Your application
Does this sound like the opportunity you’ve been waiting for? Please go ahead and apply!For questions about the position, feel free to contact Patrik Artman, 0733-908035 or patrik.artman@mpyascitech.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Director, Project Management Office (PMO), China Joint Venture Office
jobs.description:
Company description:
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Job description: 
 The opportunity 
 
 As Director of the Project Management Office (PMO) in the China Joint Venture Office, you will lead and coordinate Volvo Group/ Dongfeng Management/Group workstreams. You will establish strong PMO governance, align stakeholders across organizations, and support the delivery of shared business objectives.
  
 Working closely with senior leaders and workstream owners, you will bring structure, transparency and execution discipline to a complex, cross-organizational environment. You will also support strategic and transformation initiatives and help ensure effective communication between Volvo Group, its joint venture partners and other stakeholders.
  
 This position is located in Gothenburg, Sweden and requires frequent travel.
  
 You will report to Head of China JV Office. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1.    Lead workstreams
  Drive key workstreams in close collaboration with their leaders.
 Establish appropriate governance structures and project management practices.
 Monitor progress, risks, dependencies and decisions, and escalate issues when needed.
 Ensure workstreams remain aligned with business objectives and applicable corporate standards.
  
 
 2.    Establish and lead the PMO
  Set up and lead a JV-level PMO to govern key projects and initiatives.
 Oversee the project portfolio, including organizational transformation and JV collaboration initiatives.
 Promote disciplined project planning, resource allocation, progress tracking and reporting.
 Align project execution with Volvo Group standards while taking JV requirements and constraints into account.
 Support project negotiations when required.
  
 
 3.    Enable communication and alignment
  Drive structured communication across Volvo Group and DongFeng divisions, business areas, group functions and business units.
 Connect global, regional and JV-specific priorities.
 Support the Head of China JV Office and the leadership team with clear internal communication, decision tracking and execution follow-up.
  
 
 4.    Manage JV and external stakeholders
  Act as a key interface with JV partners, shareholders and other external stakeholders.
 Coordinate communication between Volvo Group entities and JV counterparts, ensuring clarity and compliance.
 Support executive interactions, including board meetings, shareholder discussions and strategic dialogues.
 Maintain consistent and professional external communication.
  
 
 5.    Support strategy and transformation
  Support leaders in defining and delivering JV strategy and transformation initiatives.
 Translate strategic direction into actionable programs and governance structures.
 Provide structured analysis, reporting and insights to support executive decision-making.
  
 
Profile description:Who you are
 
 
You are a structured and action-oriented leader who can bring people together and move complex initiatives forward with a can-do attitude. You communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, build alignment across organizational boundaries and maintain focus on delivery in a changing, cross-cultural environment.
 
You bring
 
 
Strong experience in PMO, project or program management, communications, strategy or consulting.
A proven track record of managing complex, cross-entity or joint venture environments.
Experience with executive-level communication and engagement with external partners.
The ability to coordinate stakeholders and teams across a complex organization.
Strong problem-solving skills, execution discipline and attention to detail.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Mandarin proficiency is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with multinational business and the China business environment is highly preferred.
 
 
 
 
For more information please contact:
 
 
John Han, Head of China JV Office, john.han@volvo.com
 
Kristina Dahm Ahlén, Talent Acquisition Partner, kristina.dahm.ahlen@volvo.com
 
 
 
Last application date is November 23.
 
 
 
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable
 
 
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
 
 
 
We offer:Who we are and what we believe in 
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Company Description
Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
But where does that take you?
To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.
And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer
(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Stockholm
In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.
The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.
On a daily basis you will
Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications
You will be a strong fit if you have
At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development. 
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.
Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.
Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are
Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

 
Additional Information

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.
The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.
You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Electronics Engineer, R&D Stockholm
Want to start your engineering career by designing the electronics inside network cameras used around the world? We're looking for an Electronics Engineer to join our growing R&D site in central Stockholm. You'll work with electronics from the first concept all the way to a finished product that's ready to sell.
 
Location: Stockholm, Sweden (on-site) | Employment: Permanent, full-time
 
Who is your future team?
Our Stockholm R&D site has grown to more than 50 colleagues. We're still early in our journey but we are growing fast. That means you can help shape how we work while being part of the world leader in network video.
We develop network-based surveillance cameras. We work in projects together with engineers and designers from other departments such as mechanics, firmware and imaging engineers. We keep processes and control to a minimum, and ideas are welcome from everyone, not just from the top. Here, your voice is heard.
 
What you'll do as an Electronics Engineer
As an Electronics Engineer at Axis, you play a central role in designing, testing and certifying the electronics in products that help make the world safer and more secure. You'll be part of the project from concept to production, until the product you and your team built is ready to be sold.
Projects vary a lot. They range from 3-month concept studies, for example in sensor technology, to 2-year projects developing advanced cameras. Your work will include:
Designing electronics, including system design, schematics and component selection
Testing and verifying your designs hands-on in the lab, including soldering
Certifying the electronics so our products meet the required standards
Working across disciplines with engineers and designers from other departments
Following the product from concept to production

 
You'll get a lot of responsibility and freedom from the start. Your mentor and experienced colleagues will support you as you grow into the role.
 
Who are you?
You're curious with an interest in technology, and electronics is what you're most passionate about. You like to take initiative and enjoy working independently. You find it easy to reach out to people and build contacts. You're thorough and take the time to understand the problem you're solving, both the big picture and the details. You enjoy sharing what you know, you stay humble, and you're motivated by working in an environment that keeps changing.
 
What you need:
A university degree in a technical field, preferably electronics
A genuine interest in electronics development
Professional proficiency in English

Bonus points for experience with any of these areas:
Soldering and modifications at PCB (printed circuit board) level

jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Engineer – Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description:
Do you want to own procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a commercially sharp engineer who wants to master the technology in depth and grow into a skilled procurement professional – in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.
What will you do at NYAB? 
As our Technical Procurement Engineer, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, driving procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. You get real responsibility from day one and a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side as you grow into the full scope of the role.
Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions.
In this role, you will: 
Own the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.

Negotiate with suppliers to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.

Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.

Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable-energy projects and make our supply-chain more resilient.

Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver.

You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does – and spotting opportunities for optimization.

About you
You are strongly goal-oriented, a self-starter with plenty of grit and a natural talent for making things happen. You bring commercial instinct, sound judgment and a genuine hunger to learn – both the technology and the art of dealmaking. For you, speed and precision go hand in hand: you take ownership of your commitments and willingly go the extra mile when it matters – while building trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners along the way.
 We believe you have: 
A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems – recently graduated or planned graduation in 2027.

Previous experience from procurement, engineering, project work, construction, energy or another technically oriented environment. 

A strong interest in sourcing, supplier management and commercial negotiations.

Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad.

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience from sourcing, supplier contacts or commercial work.

Knowledge of solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.

Why work at NYAB? 
NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it.
Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise.
You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow.
We also offer:

Comprehensive health assessments 

Generous wellness allowance  -

Parental pay supplement

Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)

A secure pension plan 

 
Ready to make it happen?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and academic records. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.
Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. Join us in building technology that drives real change.
Machine Learning Engineer at Sellpy
We look for you who want to be part of our journey to make sustainable shopping the first-hand choice by building great product recommendations, creating clever pricing algorithms and optimizing warehouse logistics with machine learning. We want to provide the best customer experience and that’s why we need you on board.
This job will suit you if you’re excited to build solutions leveraging the latest machine learning models and build custom models to solve unique challenges together with a team of highly motivated engineers.
In short, you will
Build machine learning models with a major impact on our product
Simplify, maintain and improve our already existing models
Build solutions leveraging the latest machine learning development
Keep up with ML development with the team on weekly deep dives
Make use of your skills in Tensorflow/Pytorch, Python and SQL

Requirements
B.S or M.S. degree in Computer Science or related field
At least 2 years of working experience within the machine learning field
Strong proficiency in Python
In-depth expertise about machine learning algorithms, deep learning and LLMs
Experience with ML frameworks such as Tensorflow or PyTorch
Experience with AWS or similar cloud service providers
Experience with relational databases and SQL
Experience of setting up ML systems in production
Written and spoken fluency in English

We’d be impressed if you have
Previous experience with recommender systems
Previous experience with using ML systems for item valuation
Knowledge about how to build efficient data pipelines for large data volumes
Experience working with vector databases

You’ll get to
Be part of a tech-minded company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will get direction, energy, and work on meaningful challenges daily
Benefit from hybrid work from our offices at Medborgarplatsen, Rosersberg and from home
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform
Grow professionally during monthly level-up days
Enjoy Sellpy credits and staff discounts at Sellpy and the H&M brands (Arket, COS, Other Stories, Weekday and more)
Save up with a monthly pension plan
Engagement in Sellpy’s social traditions with game nights, interactive planning days, guest speakers and other activities

Location
You are welcome to do all these things from our office at Medborgarplatsen in Stockholm, and from home. Ideally, we’d love to see you in the office frequently, as it helps create a positive and productive environment.
Hybrid work
We work flexibly but value being together. During your first period, you’ll be on-site more often to get settled. Moving forward, we maintain a 50% office presence, with some flexibility depending on your team and tasks.
Our Interview Process 🤝
We want to get to know you, your way of thinking, and how we would work together.
Culture Interview (45 min): A video call to get to know each other. We talk about your background, your drive, and why you are interested in Sellpy.
Technical Interview (1 hour): A deep dive into your technical knowledge and how you approach problem-solving.
Case Interview (2 hours): You will receive a real-world case assignment to prepare in advance. We then invite you to our office at Medborgarplatsen where you will present your solution and we will discuss your reasoning in depth.
Founder Interview (30 min): A final chat with one of our founders to discuss the company vision and your potential journey with us.

Form of employment: Full-time
Start: As agreed upon

About the company
AbbVie is one of the world’s leading research biopharma companies, and we develop innovative treatments and sustainable care solutions for severe diseases within the focus areas immunology, neurology, oncology, eyecare and virology. Patient orientation is key, and the company aims to develop specialized treatments and medicines for unsolved health problems. Our vision is to improve the lives of people affected by disease. 52+ million patients in 175+ countries are treated by AbbVie’s medicines every year.
Your role
This is a student position as a Junior Demand & Supply Coordinator, where you will be part of AbbVie’s supply chain function for Scandinavia, covering four countries including Iceland. You will report to the Manager Demand & Supply Scandinavia and work closely with Commercial, Finance, Quality, Medical and Regulatory.
The role involves a lot of hands-on operational work, from order-to-cash to warehouse and inventory flows. Many of these processes are still manual and Excel-driven, and this is where you come in. Once you understand how things work today, your main mission is to make them smarter by using AI and other tools to automate repetitive routine tasks.

Identify and automate manual processes using AI, Excel and other tools
Monitor overall inventory, including stock management
Manage pharma orders together with AbbVie’s centralized service functions and external partners, including shipping and packing notifications, certificate uploads and backorder management
Monitor wholesaler inventory and handle exceptions with internal stakeholders
Maintain master data (price, material, customer) together with the central SAP service team
Carry out internal control activities and take part in internal and external audits
Contribute to various projects across the team

Qualifications
Ongoing university studies in a relevant field, for example in IT, engineering, supply chain, logistics or finance.
Strong interest in and hands-on experience with AI tools and Excel
Familiarity with ERP systems, such as SAP, is a plus
Fluent in English, and preferably one Scandinavian language, both spoken and written
